newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Westfield to go alone on airport bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Westfield to go alone on airport bid.

text.p: Property developer and services group Westfield Holdings Ltd said on Friday it would not no longer be a joint bidder with the AGA group for Australia's airports.
Westfield said it proceed with an independent bid for the airports and would continue to participate in the bid programme.

In a joint statement, AGA managing director George Casey and Westfield managing director David Lowy said both groups had reconsidered proceeding jointly following an analysis of the airports to be included in the first tranche of airport sales.

Casey said AGA, a subsidiary of Airport Group International, the largest privately-held airport operator in the world, remained committed to pursuing the first group of airports offered by the government, namely Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth.
Lowy said Westfield's decision to proceed independently was a result of changing market conditions and the announcement that Sydney airport was unlikely to be sold before 1998.
He said Westfield would continue to participate in the bid programme.
Westfield shares closed eight cents lower at A$19.72 on turnover of 39,400 shares.
